title: Deeper/broader current peer reports, downstream workarounds, and representation seams
scope: Refresh current ACadRust cross-format reports and compare their status with downstream CADCraft workarounds
Cross-check ACadSharp numeric precision and LibreDWG Unicode route reports against Autodesk DXF transport guidance
Reconcile every issue shape with existing libdxfrw finding, subplan, source, and test owners

method.kind: Read-only web review of project-owned issue/source pages, Autodesk documentation, and local plan/source/test inventory
method.limitations: Peer issue reports and mutable source are leads, not normative format rules. CADCraft consumes the ACadRust codec lineage. ACadRust candidate commits for #130/#131 do not establish released behavior or reporter retest. No external input or peer runtime was used.

sources.observed: Open report names seven HEADER variables omitted by the reported 0.6.3 DXF writer: ANGBASE, ANGDIR, FILLETRAD, CHAMFERA, CHAMFERB, ELEVATION, and THICKNESS.

The downstream integration contains an unwritten_header_vars helper listing the same header name/group/value triples and table merge/style synchronization logic. Because CADCraft consumes ACadRust, these are application workarounds within the same codec lineage, not independent parser evidence.

sources.revision: open issue body and activity reviewed 2026-10-19
sources.observed: The report separates AC1024+ DWG merged_ranges from per-cell DXF groups 173/175/176, and DWG TABLESTYLE suppression flags from DXF groups 280/281. Candidate commits are linked, and the maintainer requested reporter retest; no retest was observed.

The report gives named pre-R2007 code-page-to-byte/scalar mismatches, including DOS437, other DOS pages, MAC-ROMAN, and JOHAB. Its expected values are to be checked against vendor mapping tables; candidate status is not a release result.
Issues #132, #133, and #134 remain visible as separate reports for custom-class/XDATA/color-name loss, unresolved-owner rehoming, and AC1032 auxiliary MLEADER-context read failures.
PR #1186 merged on 2026-08-18 and added configurable ASCII DXF writer decimal precision, closing issue #1179. This is historical peer confirmation, not a current libdxfrw defect.

The reporter describes different VALUE_TV and VALUE_TU Unicode escape expansion in DWG-to-DXF output and notes that ordinary/MTEXT/XRECORD contexts may not share one interpretation. The report does not settle the intended rule.

The reference identifies UTF-8 as the storage form for AutoCAD 2007+ DXF and also documents Unicode control sequences. Target DXF version is therefore a distinct transport axis; the treatment of escape-looking literal text remains field-specific.

existingLocalOwners.ACadRust131: PAR-05 codepage mapping and byte/scalar checks
existingLocalOwners.ACadRust132: existing custom/raw/refusal, named-color, and table-record XDATA owners
existingLocalOwners.ACadRust134: PAR-07 / S8 bounded object failure policy

assessment.implementationRefinement: For writer changes, assert literal destination tags and source identity/owner disposition before parse-back. For cross-format conversion, test each direction and canonical-to-projection field mapping separately; treat ordinary readback as a consistency check, not the sole oracle.
assessment.peerEvidenceRule: Pin package/release/commit and distinguish OPEN, CANDIDATE_FIX, REPORTER_RETESTED, and RELEASED. Same-codec read/write and downstream workarounds do not count as independent semantic evidence.
